name: L2 LAN IIH
description: Level-2 LAN Hello PDU used to discover and maintain IS-IS neighbors on broadcast segments

name: L1 LAN IIH
description: Level-1 LAN Hello PDU used on L1-only broadcast segments

name: P2P IIH
description: Point-to-point Hello PDU used on point-to-point links

name: L2 LSP
description: Level-2 Link State PDU carrying topology and reachability information

name: L1 LSP
description: Level-1 Link State PDU carrying area topology information

name: L2 CSNP
description: Complete Sequence Number PDU used for LSDB synchronization on L2 broadcast segments

name: L1 CSNP
description: Complete Sequence Number PDU used for LSDB synchronization on L1 broadcast segments

name: Area Address TLV
description: TLV 1 lists area addresses supported by the originating IS

name: Authentication TLV
description: TLV 10 carries authentication information used to verify IS-IS PDUs

name: Protocols Supported TLV
description: TLV 129 lists NLPIDs of network layer protocols supported by the IS

name: IP Interface Address TLV
description: TLV 132 lists IPv4 addresses of the originating interface

name: Dynamic Hostname TLV
description: TLV 137 carries human-readable hostname of the router

name: Extended IS Reachability TLV
description: TLV 22 describes IS neighbors with extended metrics

name: Extended IP Reachability TLV
description: TLV 135 describes IP prefixes with extended metrics

name: Padding TLV
description: TLV 8 is used to pad PDUs to desired size for MTU consistency

name: Adjacency Up
description: IS-IS neighbor adjacency has reached Up state

name: Adjacency Down
description: IS-IS neighbor adjacency has transitioned to Down state

name: LSP Sequence Number Wrap
description: LSP sequence number wrapped or jumped unexpectedly causing LSDB inconsistency

name: Area Mismatch
description: Area address in received IIH does not match local configuration

name: Authentication Mismatch
description: Authentication TLV missing or mismatched between IS-IS neighbors

name: Circuit Type Mismatch
description: L1/L2 circuit-type mismatch prevents adjacency formation

name: Hello Timer Mismatch
description: Hello or holding timer mismatch causes premature adjacency timeout

name: MTU Mismatch
description: Interface MTU mismatch prevents IS-IS PDU exchange or adjacency up

name: Duplicate System ID
description: Two routers using the same System ID causes LSP conflict

name: Link Down
description: Physical or data-link interface has gone down

name: LSP Suppression
description: IS-IS interface or process suppressed LSP generation/forwarding

name: Packet Loss and Delay
description: Emulated link degradation producing packet loss and latency

name: Router R01
description: Central star router in the simulated topology

name: Router R02
description: Fault-peer router on the focal link

name: GigabitEthernet 0/0/0
description: Default focal link interface on R01/R02

name: IS-IS process CORE
description: Named IS-IS process running on routers
